attchmntText: Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication  for the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September, 2026
voiceSummary: Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills Limited published extracts of standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 in Business Standard and Mana Telangana on 13 November 2026. The Board approved the results on 12 November 2026. Total income was Rs. 23865.47 lacs. Net profit after tax was Rs. 255.12 lacs. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 1.36. Tata Capital Housing Finance Ltd announced an e-auction of immovable properties on 30 November 2026 via auctionbazaar.com. The auction runs from 2.00 PM to 3.00 PM. Properties include flats and plots in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Reserve prices range from Rs. 2400000 to Rs. 4625000. Earnest money deposits are required. Bidders must pay 25 percent within 24 hours. Balance payment is due within 15 days.

attchmntText: Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The Board also appointed Ms. Munmun Baid as the Nodal Officer for the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority. Total assets stood at 73,950.99 lakhs as of 30 September 2026. Equity share capital remained at 2,057.83 lakhs. Total borrowings included 10,497.67 lakhs in non-current liabilities and 17,298.43 lakhs in current liabilities. Net cash flow from operating activities was negative 289.61 lakhs. Net cash flow from investing activities was negative 141.05 lakhs. Net cash flow from financing activities was positive 432.44 lakhs. The net increase in cash and cash equivalents was 1.78 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were 17.21 lakhs. Statutory auditors issued a limited review report with an unmodified conclusion.

attchmntText: Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
